fee_notes: Royalty Fee: greater of $600/month or 6% of Net Sales, subject to CPI increase. Brand Building Fund Fee: greater of $250/month or 2% of Net Sales, subject to CPI increase. Local Advertising Spend: higher of 8% of gross revenue or $4,500 per rolling 3-month period (monthly). Technology Fee: $499/month, subject to CPI increase and up to 10% annual increase. Insurance: $135-$270/month, subject to CPI and up to 10% annual increase. Convention Tickets: currently $399/franchise owner annually. Live Training Event Tickets: $99-$199/franchise owner. Assignment Fee: $500. Transfer Fee: $5,000 (existing franchisee) or $10,000 (new franchisee). Employee Transfer Fee: $7,500. Graphic Design Fee: $100/hour. Relocation Fee: $1,500-$5,000. Renewal Fee: 25% of then-current Initial Franchise Fee (reduced to $1,000 for 2026). Various other variable fees for audits, ongoing training, supplier review, quality assurance, and indemnification.

Royalty Fee2: $600 or 6% Net Sales, whichever is greater, per month. Monthly. Subject to CPI increase. The fee may be collected through billing software.
Brand Building Fund Fee: $250 or 2% of Net Sales, whichever is greater, per month. Monthly. Subject to CPI increase. The fee may be collected through billing software. See Item 11 for more information about Net Sales and the Brand Building Fund.
Local Advertising Spend, Local Marketing Fund, or Cooperative Advertising3 Contribution: The higher of 8% of gross revenue or $4,500 per rolling three (3)-month period.3 Monthly. See Item 11 for more information about our right to set up and require participation in a Local Marketing Fund or an advertising cooperative.
Technology Fee4: $499 per month. Monthly. The fee may be collected through billing software. Subject to CPI increase. In addition, we may increase this fee annually up to 10%.
Insurance: $135 - $270 per month. Monthly or annually. Subject to CPI increase. In addition, we may increase this fee annually up to 10%. The fee may be collected through billing software.
